description: Edit rendered slides of a ready deck, one entry per slide number: new copy, a fixed number, a different layout, a real image or live webpage screenshot to feature (imageUrl, screenshotUrl), or exact images pasted into boxes (placeImages). Paid plans only. Up to 10 placeImages-only revisions (no instructions, imageUrl, or screenshotUrl) finish before the call returns, with phase ready and the new slideImageUrls. Other edits return at once; call genppt_get_deck with waitSeconds to see the new images.

deckId.description: Deck id from genppt_list_decks, genppt_create_deck, or genppt_create_slideshow.

imageUrl.description: Public image URL (logo, product UI, chart, photo) for the redraw to feature on this slide.

instructions.description: What to change on this slide. Optional when imageUrl, screenshotUrl, or placeImages is given. With placeImages it only describes the paste.

placeImages.description: Paste exact images into boxes on the slide (fractions 0-1 of the slide) with no redraw. Keeps real pixels: use it for logos and screenshots that must stay exact. Keep nearby text outside each box. Not with imageUrl or screenshotUrl; make that change in a separate call.

cover.description: True when the box is over a drawn copy of this image: the box is filled with the surrounding color first.

screenshotUrl.description: Public webpage to screenshot live and paste into the box.

url.description: Public image URL to paste into the box unchanged.

x.description: Left edge as a fraction of the slide width.

y.description: Top edge as a fraction of the slide height.

screenshotUrl.description: Public webpage URL to screenshot live and feature on this slide in the redraw.

name: genppt_revise_slides
title: Revise slides
